services.desc: Questions? The Student Services Center is here to quickly answer your questions. Research tells us that skills campers learn at camp last far beyond their camp experience. We are committed to offering camps and hands-on learning for youth that enrich lives, encourage meaningful interaction and build foundational life-skills. Registration for camps opens on January 26, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Registration opened on January 26th, 2026 at 10:00 a.m. Be sure to check out our camp options below! blurb: Community theatre and arts are vibrant in the Real North. Bayshore Arts Center is home to Theatre on the Bay, Children’s Theatre, the West Shore Chorale and the Fine Arts Gallery. These programs have been entertaining residents and visitors for decades.
